name: Lyria 3.5
description: Google's flagship music generation model, optimized for full-length songs with complex structural coherence including multiple verses, choruses, and bridges. Generates 44.1 kHz stereo audio from text prompts or image inputs and returns MP3 audio with lyric text.

sources.title: Lyria 3.5 model page
sources.notes: Stable model code, supported data types, and the 131,072 token input limit. The page states an input token limit only, so no output limit is recorded.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Billed at $0.08 per generated song, not per token, so no token pricing is recorded.
